t: A rugged touchscreen Meshtastic messenger that texts off the grid with no phone.
steps: Buy the WisMesh Tap V2 from the RAKwireless store. Pick the radio band for your country.
Screw the LoRa antenna on tightly before you power it on.
Charge it from a 5 volt 2 amp USB-C wall adapter.
Turn it on and set your region on the touchscreen.
Send a test message to a friend with a second Meshtastic node.
Install the Meshtastic app on your phone and pair it over Bluetooth.
Copy map tiles to a microSD card and view them on the screen.
Update the firmware with the Meshtastic web flasher over USB.
meta: Open Board. From $109. A few stores.
